validation_status: CANDIDATE - rejected by its gate (E140 decision C); validation pending; not a released forecast
claim: Structural relative-risk estimate for the display quarter, issued with information public before the issue date. Its only out-of-time evidence is survey-to-survey (train 2015 + 2018, predict the 2019 provincial round; development data). No quarterly provincial food-insecurity measurement exists, so quarter-to-quarter change is NOT validated.
explanation_method: exact TreeSHAP (sums with the base value to the predicted relative logit)
interval_note: model-refit uncertainty (16-region bootstrap, 200 refits); excludes survey sampling error and temporal change, so it understates the total uncertainty
class_rule: HIGH if the whole 90 % interval is >= 0.5, LOW if it is < 0.5, otherwise UNCERTAIN
meaning: Estimated probability that the province's household food insecurity (HFIAS moderate-or-severe) is above the national level. A risk estimate: HIGH does not confirm food insecurity and LOW does not guarantee food security. It is not the share of food-insecure households.
